change_summary: Research-only CBB first- and second-half model: rebuilt public sportsdataverse ESPN PBP dataset (2019-2026; the reported 6,297-game set was not found and is not claimed), chronological residual fits, integer-PMF distributions, and push-aware pricing for spread, total, moneyline and both team totals, with pregame H2 and halftime-adjusted H2 labelled separately. Adds a margin/total copula and H1-H2 Gaussian copula (kind chosen on 2021-2025 folds, fit on 2019-2025; 2026 is a secondary re-use only), a refit path onto FG1C full-game projections that refuses to train on 2026 or overwrite v1, and a totals-bias plan that forbids a post-test intercept fix. Dedicated workflow cbb-halves.yml runs both test suites. PAPER/0u, NON_COUNTED, approved_stake_u=0.
assumptions: The 6,297-game H1 dataset reported in issue #57 was not located; this PR rebuilds from public sportsdataverse files and does not claim to be that dataset.
Season 2026 was scored once for the univariate v1 model. Joint metrics on 2026 are a secondary re-use of that window, not a first untouched test. unseen_data_verified remains false.

Joint copulas do not change v1 means or SDs. Margin-total residual correlation is small; the useful fitted structure is H1-H2 total residual correlation of about +0.13. The empirical copula candidate lost on every dev fold and is not used.

The FG1C mean refit is a separate coefficient file. It is trained only through 2025 and the CLI refuses to overwrite coefficients_halves_v1.json. Walk-forward JSON used for the refit lives outside the repo; source sha256s are in results/fg1c_projections_source_manifest.json.

Known totals bias is disclosed in research/cbb_halves/TOTALS_BIAS.md and is not corrected on the 2026 test window. Hosted workflow cbb-halves.yml runs both halves.test_halves (from models/cbb) and research.cbb_halves.test_halves_research. A green check is not validation or a staking authorization.

baseline.metric: legacy H1 margin MAE on held-out season 2026
